method: meta-device structural reconstruction of official NVIDIA constructors; no weights loaded
unused_reg_token_explanation: Official extra_timm_models.vit_base_patch16_v2_224 creates reg_tokens=4. Official _enable_cpe_for_timm_vit removes patch_embed/cls_token/pos_embed/pos_drop, but does not remove reg_token; the registered 3072 parameters remain in the official module count.
timm_fixed512_note: Official timm model card states a native remap with no additional training: 128x128 CPE is resized once to 32x32 with RADIO interpolation. Outputs match original at 512x512; other resolutions drift. Numerical equality was not independently weight-tested in this audit.
rgb_normalization_note: RGB counts preserve original 3-channel patch embedding. Summing 3-channel weights into grayscale removes 393216 parameters, but preserving exact pretrained RGB behavior also requires consistent input normalization.
